task.title: Preventing payment of the EI Emergency Response Benefit (EI ERB)

step.cmd: Determine which of the following situations applies and create the appropriate RODs in NWS as follows:

ul.li:
A D47 must be imposed. No previously imposed D47 must be modified or rescinded:
Comments: Type “Not eligible — D47 disentitlement from [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X]. A 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement has been imposed for this period.”
Click Save .

There are 4-week periods for which a D47 does not apply:
Comments: Type “Earnings reviewed [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings do not exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X]. No disentitlement is imposed.”
Click Save .

The start and end date of a 4-week period for which a D47 was previously imposed must be modified:
Comments: Type “Not entitled — D47 disentitlement modified to [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] and a 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement has been imposed for this period. The previous 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement imposed from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] has been rescinded.”
Click Save .

The end date of a 4-week period for which a D47 was previously imposed must be modified:
Comments: Type “Not entitled — D47 disentitlement modified to [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X]. The previous 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement imposed from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] has been modified.”
Click Save .

A previously imposed D47 must be rescinded and a new D47 must be imposed:
Comments: Type “Not entitled — D47 disentitlement modified to [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] and a 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement has been imposed for this period. The previous 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement imposed from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] has been rescinded.”
Click Save .

A previously imposed D47 must be rescinded:
Comments: Type “Earnings reviewed [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Type “Monies are considered earnings. Earnings do not exceed $1 000 in the 4-week period of the EI Emergency Response Benefit paid from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X]. No disentitlement imposed. The previous 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the 4-week period disentitlement imposed from week code [XXXX-X] to week code [XXXX-X] has been rescinded.”
Click Save .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 13.

If no , select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .
Go to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine the CS:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 15.
If the claim is terminated and cannot be reactivated, go to step 23.

If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated:
On the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Click Reactivate .
Go to step 14.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Input the disentitlement.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If an existing D47 must be modified, go to step 16.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and a new D47 input, go to step 17.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and no new D47 must be input, go to step 19.
If a new D47 must be input, go to step 21.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If the start and end dates must be modified, go to step 17.
If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 20.

step.cmd: On day one, in FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction to impose the D47 with the correct dates as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select the D47 that must be amended.
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Correct disentitlement input — original disentitlement will be rescinded on day 2.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: On day 2, in FTS, click the Disqualifications/Disentitlements link to remove the original D47 as follows:

ul.li: Click the original disentitlement.
Click Modify .

When the Disqualification/Disentitlements (M161) transaction opens, complete the following fields:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Rescind .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts-entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Click Update .
Go to step 22.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and modify the end date of the D47 as follows:

ul.li: Click the original disentitlement.
Click Modify .

When the Disqualification/Disentitlements (M161) transaction opens, complete the following fields:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select T - Terminate/Modify .
End date: Enter the correct disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts-entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes.
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No.
Click Update .
Go to step 22.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and impose a D47 for the appropriate period as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
To clear the registration number, C - Yes .
Click Update .
Go to step 22.

step.cmd: Determine if a disentitlement for another 4-week period must be input or modified:

ul.li: If yes, return to step 15.
If no, go to step 49.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 13.
If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 24.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 46.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 25.
If all rows are blank, go to step 27.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 25.
If all rows are blank, go to step 27.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If an existing D47 must be modified, go to step 28.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and a new D47 input, go to step 29.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and no new D47 must be input, go to step 34.
If a new D47 must be input, go to step 42.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If the start and end dates must be modified, go to step 29.
If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 38.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 -Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Click Update .

step.cmd: On day one, on the Disentitlements tab, input up to 4 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period disentitlements (D47) on the Disentitlements section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date, if necessary.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 32.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 33.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Click Update .
Click Close .
Return to step 29.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Correct disentitlement input — original disentitlement will be rescinded on day 2.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On day 2, on the Disentitlements tab, rescind up to 4 D47s on the Disentitlements section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select X - Rescind .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 37.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 49.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Click Update .
Click Close .
Return to step 34.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, rescind up to 4 D47s on the Disentitlements section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select T - Terminate .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 41.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 49.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Click Update .
Click Close .
Return to step 38.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, rescind up to 4 D47s on the Disentitlements section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 45.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 49.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Click Update .
Click Close .
Return to step 42.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the disentitlement to be input.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave this field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “[Add, modify, or rescind, as appropriate] D47 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 2–4: If there are additional disentitlement periods that require input or modification, type “D47 from w/c [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .
Go to step 49.
